referenceFacts.facts: The pavilion was installed on June 20, 2022. The open ends face due north and south. The interior was backfilled with local soil.

referenceFacts.record: Research by Douglas Noble and Karen Kensek
referenceFacts.facts: One foundation panel and two pairs of rotated wall and roof panels form an anticlastic thin-shell structure. The UHPC is approximately two inches thick at its thinnest.
Overall length 42 feet and height 13 feet. Pink concrete uses weathering steel fibre reinforcement. The near-200 diagrid perforations differ in size and shape.

nativeMapFinding: The published pavilion coordinate is more specific than the rounded story coordinate. The USC design team's installation record supports the north–south heading. The reviewed 2022 federal orthophoto predates installation, and the nearby mapped footprints are unrelated. The nominal anchor has not been verified against a post-installation aerial survey.
